buyer_hypotheses: ED operations leadership may own arrival and treatment-space planning.
Inpatient flow or bed-management leadership may own readiness and boarding.
data_needs: Staffed capacity and inpatient bed readiness timestamps
discovery_questions: Where does patient flow become constrained during high demand?
Who owns the decision and the operational response?
Which arrival, staffing, bed, and discharge signals are available?
What small pilot would be safe and useful to evaluate?
pilot_scope: One operational workflow and one customer-approved owner
Historical or operational data assessment before any prediction claim
A customer-agreed success measure rather than an invented target
rationale: Simulated discovery feedback changed the priority toward inpatient readiness; public evidence still does not establish buyer intent, available data, or pilot value.
recommendation: Prioritize discovery about inpatient bed readiness and discharge coordination before evaluating ED arrival forecasting.
